plugins.name: luna-correlate
plugins.description: Offline health-factor correlation MCP (Posture A). Cross-references local health/status series against external factors — Kp geomagnetic index (date-only) and location factors (barometric pressure, pollen, air-quality) resolved offline via a proximity index — and surfaces ranked CANDIDATE signals with caveats; never a diagnosis, never causation. Only the gated factors.cache fetcher touches the network (country-level grid, no PHI, no operator coordinates).

Carries 11 of superpowers' 14 (the four himmel uses plus the seven they hand off to - the `superpowers:<name>` reference closure) and grilling from mattpocock/skills; drops using-superpowers, whose SessionStart injection is most of the reclaimed context. Also hosts himmel's own context7-mcp skill, moved out of ~/.claude/skills because plugin membership is the only lever that scopes a skill to a profile. Upstream advance is detected at the release level by the superpowers-skills and mattpocock-skills rows in scripts/upstreams.json; repair is a reviewed re-vendor, never a synced_base bump. See marketplace/plugins/lean-skills/VENDORED.md.

plugins.name: claude-obsidian

Wiki query, save, ingest, lint, autoresearch. Companion to obsidian-triage — its wiki-query skill optionally powers the Phase 4 Related Notes link-graph traversal. Sourced via an explicit HTTPS git url (NOT the `github` shorthand, which clones over SSH and fails host-key verification on a fresh machine with no github.com in ~/.ssh/known_hosts — HIMMEL-549). Pinned to an immutable tag per himmel supply-chain policy (a bare commit SHA is NOT installable — `claude plugin install` clones via `git clone --branch <ref>`, which only resolves branch/tag names; see marketplace/plugins/obsidian-triage/README.md § Pin update workflow). Fork `yotamleo/claude-obsidian` retired at v2.2.0 — its delta (#178 UTF-8 guards, #179 CRLF report) landed upstream (HIMMEL-2925).
